style.title: Budget style
style.haveNow: How much do you have right now?
style.pauses: Your budget pauses. Nothing is deleted. You can come back anytime.
style.resumes: Your budget starts again with what it held. A short Welcome back follows.

FLEX.name: Flex
FLEX.sub: Bills and savings first. One Spending number for everything else.
FLEX.lead: Left to spend, and per day.

EVERY_DOLLAR.name: Every dollar
EVERY_DOLLAR.sub: An envelope for each category. You assign all money in.

SAVE_FIRST.name: Save first
SAVE_FIRST.sub: A share of each paycheck goes to savings before anything else.

LIMITS.name: Limits
LIMITS.sub: Limits on what you care about. Everything else is tracked.
LIMITS.lead: Left in your limits, with pace.

FIFTY_THIRTY_TWENTY.sub: Half to needs, 30% to wants, 20% to savings.
FIFTY_THIRTY_TWENTY.lead: Needs, Wants and Savings as a share of money in.

WEEKLY.name: Weekly
WEEKLY.sub: One spending number that resets every week.
WEEKLY.lead: Left this week, and per day.

TRACK.name: Just track
TRACK.sub: See where money goes, with no budget to keep.

DEBT_PAYOFF.name: Debt payoff
DEBT_PAYOFF.sub: Minimums on time, extra to one debt at a time.
DEBT_PAYOFF.lead: Debt-free by, and what you owe.

takeBack.title: Take back {amount}
takeBack.lead: You planned <amount></amount> more than you have. This takes it back from what has money left. Bills stay as they are.
takeBack.nothing: Nothing is planned beyond what you have.
takeBack.toast: Took back what you planned beyond what you have

fundNow.title: Fund {next} now
fundNow.lead: This takes {next}'s plan out of what this month has not planned yet and puts it in {next}'s envelopes now.
fundNow.noPlan: There is no plan for next month yet. Plan it first, then fund it.

reconcile.title: Does this match your bank?
reconcile.lead: Compares what the budget holds with the accounts that are part of it. A difference is recorded as one adjustment.
reconcile.incomplete: Some accounts have no rate today, so this is not complete.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
welcomeBack.leadNone: No month closed on its own while you were away.

about.CATCH_UP: Opens the summaries of the months that closed, in order.
about.SET_HAVE_NOW: Records one adjustment from the money you have now. Envelopes keep what they hold.
about.START_FRESH: Returns every envelope's money to Not planned yet. Envelopes, targets, rules and history stay.

welcomeBack.catchUpNothing: Nothing changes. You are only reading.

toast.START_FRESH: Started fresh. Every envelope's money is back in Not planned yet

close.title: {month} is closed
close.notClosed: This month has not closed yet.
close.late: Includes {count, plural, one {# late expense} other {# late expenses}}

carry.title: Take it from {month}'s {name}
carry.lead: {name} went over last month. This takes it from {name} in {month} instead of from the money you have not planned. {name} may start {month} below zero.

forgive.title: Forgive {name}
forgive.nothing: Nothing is owed to you here.
forgive.effect: It comes off {name}'s balance. No money comes back, so Not planned yet does not change. Nothing is sent to {name}.

owed.title: Owed to you
owed.nobody: Nobody owes you money the budget holds.
owed.incomplete: Some amounts have no rate today and are not counted.

toAssign.meaning: Money that came in and has no job yet. Give it a job with Assign. Nothing is blocked; it is just not planned.

leftToSpend.meaning: What is left in Spending this month. Money for bills, savings and money not planned yet is not in it.

leftInLimits.meaning: What you can still spend before each limit, added up.

envelope.meaning: Money set aside for one purpose, like Groceries or Rent. One envelope can cover several categories.

target.meaning: What an envelope aims for: an amount each month, or a goal by a date.

left.meaning: What an envelope still holds this month.

overBy.meaning: You spent more than the envelope held. Cover it from another envelope, or it comes out of next month.

cover.meaning: Move money from another envelope to fill a gap. Bills are never suggested.

carries.meaning: What is left at month end stays in the envelope. You can change this for each envelope.

moneyIn.meaning: Salary, a client paying, a refund. It lands in Not planned yet.

owed.meaning: What people owe you for things you paid. It comes back when they pay.

explain.assignedAheadHint: It waits there until the month starts.
explain.overspendHint: Envelopes that went over in closed months.
explain.heldHint: Money you fronted that people still owe you. It returns when they pay.
explain.leftToSpendTitle: How Left to spend adds up

rules.title: Income rules
rules.lead: What happens when money arrives, in the order the rules run. Every move shows in history with Undo.
rules.none: No rules yet. Money that arrives stays Not planned yet until you assign it.

editor.title: Add rule
editor.name: Name
editor.note: It runs on money that arrives from now on. Nothing moves today.

apply.title: Apply {name} to this month
apply.lead: A rule only runs on money that arrives after it exists. This runs it once on money that already came in this month.
apply.toast: Applied {name} to this month's money in

whatIf.title: What if I spend in {name}
whatIf.lead: A pretend expense. Nothing is saved.
whatIf.cannot: This cannot be previewed as typed.
whatIf.idle: Type an amount to see what it would do.

coverAll.title: Cover overspending
coverAll.lead: Each envelope that went over takes what it needs from {pool}.

coverAll.toastShort: Covered {count, plural, one {# envelope} other {# envelopes}}

fromWealth.toastCounted: Counted money from {name}. {name} did not change
